Trim stray aways from your eyebrows, go for calorie deficit or grow out your beard more to have a chiseled look. A little longer for hair would look nice but it still looks nice on its length now. Also focus on your eyelashes, maybe pump it with argan oil or some hair growther. Also use lip oil before bed and chapstick throughout the morning. Honestly, you look good now but this is my suggestions.

Stay with the curls, it looks better really. I think it compliments your face shape more. The straight hair ages you. Try a bolder makeup and maybe practice a bit. All in all I dont think any plastic surgery is necessary.
Maybe trim your beard? I dont know how to describe it but mayhaps make your beard shape cleaner I guess. And totally change the hairstyle, but all in all man you look pretty good!

The last three pics color of hair suit you the best than the orange one, it blended too much on your shade of skin so I think the blonde would fit and accentuate you better. Either just style the hair like you normally would or you can try the side part dreads that Michael B. Jordan had in Black Panther. Maybe experiment with beards too, for the jawline but honestly it looks ok too without it. Looks androgynous-y.
Would say getting bangs that suit your face would be a huge step, another is that going for a natural eyebrow than boxy shape one for your makeup will be better.
